description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BorderRendererBase' used for rendering borders in RTF documents within the MigraDoc library. It includes methods for rendering borders, determining default colors, and handling border control identifiers based on border type. The class is part of the namespace 'MigraDoc.RtfRendering' and interacts with document object models for paragraphs and table cells.

classes.name: BorderRendererBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for rendering borders in RTF, providing common functionalities for BorderRenderer and BordersRenderer classes.

methods.name: RenderBorder
methods.description: Renders a single border control for the specified border control string, considering visibility, style, color, and width properties.

methods.name: GetDefaultColor
methods.description: Retrieves the default color for borders, using the font color of the parent format if available.

methods.name: GetBorderControl
methods.description: Returns the RTF control string for the specified border type, adjusting for table cell borders if necessary.
